title: BloxMC
description: Client-side modpack for the BloxMC multiplayer roleplay server, inspired by Garry’s Mod DarkRP. Built for Fabric on Minecraft 1.21.1.
body:
Step into a living sandbox roleplay world built on Fabric 1.21.1, heavily inspired by Garry’s Mod DarkRP.

BloxMC is a multiplayer-focused modpack designed to be used when connecting to the BloxMC server. Choose a role, earn money, own property, run businesses, enforce (or break) the law, and shape the economy through player interaction.

From street crime and police raids to shops, jobs, and city life, every action matters. This server focuses on immersive roleplay, progression, and player-driven freedom—where stories are created by the players, not scripts.

Loader: Fabric
Minecraft Version: 1.21.1

Developed by FirePhox/FirePh0x.

Our website: https://bloxmc.online
